Play in landscape mode on mobile. Scores and preferences are saved in this browser. Use Escape to pause; in fullscreen, Escape returns to this page.

How to play

Keyboard and mouse: move with A/D or Left/Right Arrow. Aim with the mouse or Up/Down Arrow. Stop moving and hold the left mouse button to shoot. Hold Space for gravity. Escape pauses.

Touchscreen: hold the left/right buttons to move. Stop, then hold and drag on AIM / SHOOT to aim and fire. Hold GRAVITY for the gravity field. Tap Pause to pause.

Local scores stay on this device and are not shared with CrazyGames. An unfinished run is not saved.
